assessor: direct source-bound inspection by Codex; separate from generator and full live audit
source_quote: Level 1 measures outputs: assets published, proof labels completed, partner packs delivered and approved claims linked to proof.

findings.finding: Counts evidenced delivery to the named partner/buyer route. Excludes preparation, failed delivery and duplicate records, while preserving deliveries with no later download, briefing or lead. Appropriate partner proof pack card.

Counts campaign assets actually distributed to intended audiences with publication-channel evidence. Excludes drafts, approval-only and internal review records. Appropriate campaign close scorecard card; no invented published totals.

findings.measure: Earned coverage quality for the Month4 proof launch
findings.finding: Explicit Month4 population includes unfavorable and low-quality items. Retains all seven source-listed criteria and unavailable aggregate until agreed threshold exists. Does not substitute Month10 activity.

findings.measure: Influencer or creator committed-output delivery per creator
findings.finding: Population is upfront commitments for eligible participating creators, not independent journalists. Keeps blog/longpost,3-5 updates,2-3 per live-challenge-day and agreed-pieces categories. Missing commitment or selected range value makes creator-category aggregate unavailable; no fabricated engagement, contract or target.

limitation: Operational definitions, not evidence that an instrument or observations already exist. Counts use declared channel/period scope; these are not unique-person metrics. Creator commitment population must be read per creator/category as explicitly required; independent editorial activity is not a commitment.
